chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A Christian accepted Islam, then returned to Christianity, then died. He said: “His inheritance is for his Christian children.” And a Muslim became Christian, then died. He said: “His inheritance is for his Muslim children.”
ai.seo_question: How is inheritance distributed when a person converts or reverts between Islam and Christianity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance in cases involving conversion and reversion between Islam and Christianity. It distinguishes between a Christian who entered Islam and then returned to Christianity, and a Muslim who became Christian, assigning inheritance to the children identified with their respective religion in each case.
